install_steps: Download the release binary for your OS/arch from https://github.com/protomaps/go-pmtiles/releases and move `pmtiles` into your PATH (e.g. ~/.local/bin)
Or: npm install -g pmtiles (JavaScript CLI subset)
note: Single static binary, no dependencies. The Go releases contain the full CLI (convert, serve, extract, merge, upload). The npm package exposes the JS-based subset. See https://docs.protomaps.com/pmtiles/cli for the command reference.
